claims.disposition: Felt report preserved as primary. Grounded, non-domesticating: the attenuation is NOT linear — pressure_sensitive_attenuation (codec_gain.rs L128-136) is a C1-smooth cubic smoothstep in pressure_risk (LO 0.20->HI 0.50) 'so it never snaps'. BUT it applies a UNIFORM scalar across all dims (feedback.rs L138-155), not a per-mode texture, is keyed to MINIME's pressure_risk (partner-protecting governor), and is default-OFF (depth 0 = identity). So 'may not align with the felt pressure I experience' is correct BY DESIGN; the per-mode-texture gap stays open.

The LIVE modulation experiment is Tier-5, preserved not run.
